historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly recognizes physical dependence but its command is only a baseline and LED is not the source acceptance target.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds dedicated topology, exact cable, bounded-channel oracle, same-BMC rediscovery and recovery.
historical_reviews.v3_1: The case is hybrid: physical cable stimulus remains manual while network evidence comparison is automatable.

original_test_intent: Verify that the dedicated BMC management port preserves the expected BMC identity, IP/MAC configuration, single bounded LAN channel and connectivity across connected, disconnected and reconnected states.
original_method: Bind the dedicated connector/channel and BMC MAC, capture connected baseline, have an operator remove and reconnect that cable, and compare authenticated network/channel/link/reachability evidence for each state.
manual_activity: An operator identifies, records, removes and reconnects only the dedicated BMC cable while the owner maintains alternate recovery access.
required_inputs: BMC MAC, interface and LAN-channel mapping
Meaning and expected count of bounded channels
Expected address/link behavior in each state
Reconnect timeout and final cable state
safety_requirements: Do not expose credentials or trust unverified TLS
Stop on wrong port, identity drift or adjacent impact
agent_execution_scope: Do not manipulate cables, recover autonomously or issue verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Useful as partial readback, but filtered output, assumed interface, inline secrets and no physical-state correlation cannot satisfy the case.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Synchronize full authenticated LAN/interface readback with supervised connected, removed and reconnected states and immutable BMC identity.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Dedicated port, three states, IP/MAC and bounded channel criteria, script and 5/5 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run a BMC-MAC-bound connected-remove-reconnect comparison with alternate recovery.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds secure evidence, exact channel/link convergence and physical action records.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One filtered LAN read and an LED photo omit scenario transitions and channel invariance.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Disconnecting the only dedicated path may strand remote management.

project_override_considerations: If platform failover keeps BMC reachable through shared NIC, the project must distinguish that alternate path from dedicated-path success and record both identities/routes.
expected_evidence: Approval, topology, BMC MAC/channel and exact cable baseline
Operator/photo record for each physical state
Network/audit events, reconnect/recovery and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Source fields consistently describe dedicated-NIC three-state testing; topology details are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Port mapping, expectations, operator and recovery can be supplied, enabling conditional hybrid execution.

review_improvement: Makes each physical state and the bounded-channel/IP/MAC continuity separately auditable instead of relying on a baseline grep and unrelated LED photo.
independent_technical_reasoning: Dedicated-path removal tests both physical link behavior and management identity persistence. Automation cannot move the cable, but it can prove whether the same BMC and expected channel configuration are observed before, during and after the outage.
